meta.title: Word to PDF - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF in your browser. Formatting preserved locally — no server upload.
wordToPdfNote: Text-based conversion — text content is extracted and laid out in a clean PDF. Complex styles, images, and tables may not transfer.
desc: Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF in your browser. Formatting preserved locally — no server upload.
invalidDocx: Invalid file. Please upload a .docx Word document — PDFs and images are not supported.
emptyDoc: No text in the document. It may be empty or contain only images.
readDocxFail: Could not read the document. Make sure it is a valid .docx Word file.
